description: Test suite for Slack target parsing and normalization functions, verifying correct parsing of user/ channel identifiers, normalization, and error handling.

methods.name: parseSlackTarget
methods.description: Parses a Slack target string into a structured object with kind, id, and normalized form.

methods.name: resolveSlackChannelId
methods.description: Resolves a channel identifier, stripping prefix if present, or throws error if input is invalid.

methods.name: normalizeSlackMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a Slack messaging target string to a standard format, defaulting raw IDs to channel format.
